# CAPHE - California Association of Public Health Economists
# https://www.caphegroup.org

## About
CAPHE (California Association of Public Health Economists) is a professional association founded in 2024 that provides health economics training, cost-effectiveness analysis tools, and peer collaboration for economists working across California's 57 county public health departments.

## Key Resources

- [ROI Calculator](https://www.caphegroup.org/tools/lha-calculator): Free peer-reviewed tool calculating mortality reduction and ROI from county public health spending. Based on Lewbel IV estimation of California county data (2003-2023); each $10 per capita in public health spending reduces mortality by 9.16 deaths per 100,000.
- [Medi-Cal Provider Access Explorer](https://www.caphegroup.org/tools/access-explorer): Interactive tool measuring Medi-Cal provider participation across California's 58 counties. Cross-references NPPES provider data with HHS Medicaid claims to show the share of providers actively billing Medi-Cal by specialty (primary care, behavioral health, dental, OB-GYN, pediatrics), with practice-cost overlays and monthly trends 2018-2024.
- [Methods Lab](https://www.caphegroup.org/methods-lab/): 37 interactive tutorials on health economics methods, including causal inference (confounding, collider bias, selection, reverse causation), difference-in-differences and parallel-trends diagnostics, threats to internal validity (history, maturation, regression to the mean, instrumentation), and cost-effectiveness analysis (ICERs, decision thresholds, budget impact, sensitivity analysis). Worked examples use Medicaid expansion, CHW programs, and food-insecurity data.
- [Health Economics Data Sources](https://www.caphegroup.org/resources/health-economics-data-sources): Curated directory of health economics datasets and databases — CMS, HCUP/AHRQ, BRFSS, NHIS, NHANES, MEPS, Census ACS, BLS, BEA, California HHS Open Data, OECD, and WHO — with coverage, access, and use-case notes.
- [Resources](https://www.caphegroup.org/resources): Tools, datasets, and references for health economists in California public health.
- [Programs](https://www.caphegroup.org/programs): Webinars, workshops, working groups, and peer review sessions.
- [Webinar Recordings](https://www.caphegroup.org/recordings): Recorded webinars on health economics topics with speaker information and key takeaways.
- [Membership](https://www.caphegroup.org/membership): Free community and paid professional membership tiers for public health economists across California.
